text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy,<n>something
catches Grass Wonder's<n>attention.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look't these... They're all so<n>pretty!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe! What's that you're looking at?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh—hi, Grass! And... hello, Trainer!<n>How are you this
evening?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was just looking at the kimonos<n>over in that shop
window! Look,<n>aren't they pretty?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're gorgeous... and all made<n>from a
high-end hemp fabric, it<n>seems.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A what? Y-you must know a lot about<n>clothes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I dabble a little, is all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aw, I'm jealous. I bet you're used to<n>wearing
kimonos like these, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I only got to wear one for<n>Shichi-Go-San when I
was little. My<n>mom got it for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that makes me envious of<n>you, Spe. I
never got to celebrate<n>Shichi-Go-San when I was
growing<n>up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, that's right. You were in<n>America, weren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Out of everyone I knew, I was<n>the only one
with my own kimono.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I wished I could dress up<n>together with
girls my age.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without losing her usual smile, Grass<n>Wonder
gazes distantly into the shop<n>window.
choice_data_list: Why don't you two dress up now, then?
How about we hold a race in kimonos?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now as in... right now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at the sign, Grass! It says<n>we can try
them on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Hehe. So that's what youwere referring to.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So you... don't mind if we take this<n>small detour?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Hehe. Now, which to put<n>on... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder tries on kimonos with<n>Special Week,
looking as happy as<n>can be.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Goodness. Hehe. That sounds like a<n>blast.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! But I, uh... I don't know how<n>to put it on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's no need to fret, Spe. I'll help<n>you out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And of course, you'll be joining us<n>as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
By all means. One of these days, we<n>should go
kimono shopping for you<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I wonder what design would<n>suit you best.
♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder appears to have<n>thoroughly
enjoyed herself today.
